ACTIVITY_DESC_ORG: Review organization-level activity for investigation and troubleshooting.
ACTIVITY_DESC_WORKSPACE: Review workspace-level activity for investigation and troubleshooting.
ACTIVITY_EMPTY_DESC: Try adjusting the time range or filters.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_REQUE: A password reset request was issued (no sensitive data).
ACTIVITY_EVENT_AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_COMPL: The user completed the password reset flow.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_STATUS_U: A workspace member was enabled or disabled.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_ROLES_UP: A workspace member's roles were updated.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_PROFILE_: An admin updated member profile fields (e.g. display name, email, avatar).
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_MEMBER_PASSWORD: An admin reset a workspace member password.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_EMAIL_CR: An email invite was created for a workspace.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_EMAIL_UP: An existing email invite was updated (e.g. role/expiry).
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_EMAIL_RE: The expiry of an email invite was extended.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_LINK_CRE: A shareable invite link was created for a workspace.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_LINK_REN: The expiry of an invite link was extended.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_LINK_DIS: An invite link was disabled and can no longer be used.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_WORKSPACE_INVITE_ACCEPTED: An invited user accepted the workspace invitation.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_RBAC_ROLE_CREATED_DESC: A new RBAC role was created in the workspace.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_RBAC_PERMISSION_ROLES_SET: The roles associated with a permission were updated.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_RBAC_ROLE_PERMISSIONS_SET: The permissions granted to a role were updated.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_SYSTEM_SETUP_COMPLETED_DE: The system initialization flow has completed.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_SETTINGS_UPDATED_DESC: System or plugin settings were updated.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_PLUGIN_INSTALLED_DESC: A plugin package was installed into the system.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_PLUGIN_ENABLED_DESC: A plugin was enabled and is now active.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_PLUGIN_DISABLED_DESC: A plugin was disabled and is no longer active.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_ASSET_UPLOADED_DESC: A file upload was completed and persisted as an asset.
ACTIVITY_EVENT_UNKNOWN_DESC: This event has no localized copy yet. Review the event code or add a catalog mapping.
